name: email-deliverability

renderer_definitions.name: email_template_builder
renderer_definitions.description: Simplified email template builder with guided org/workspace discovery, saved template selection, deterministic HTML-to-text preview, variable extraction, large HTML preview, durable workspace artifact search/load, and TribeX workspace JSON persistence.
renderer_definitions.rule: Use `email_template_builder` when the user wants to draft or edit a reusable HTML email template, choose a TribeX organization/workspace, select a saved durable template or create a new one, inspect explicit `{{variable}}` placeholders, preview HTML and derived plain text against a sample row, save the draft to TribeX AI workspace storage, or inspect advanced artifact/campaign fields only when needed.

registry_index.summary: Simplified email template drafting with org/workspace discovery, saved template selection, deterministic HTML-to-text preview, durable artifact search/load, and artifact-backed previews for TribeX AI email deliverability.

tool_groups.name: Template Builder
tool_groups.hint: Open, select organization/workspace, choose saved templates or create a new draft, validate variables, preview HTML plus deterministic plain text, and save deterministic template drafts for TribeX AI workspace storage.

tool_rules.email-template-builder-open: Returns a lightweight payload for the `email_template_builder` renderer. Use `push_content` with tool_name `email_template_builder` and the returned data to open the UI.
tool_rules.email-template-payload-validate: Validates explicit `{{variable}}` placeholders against normalized JSON audience rows. Missing variables block persona test prompt generation.
tool_rules.email-template-persona-test-prompt: Builds a safety-scoped prompt for a TribeX AI persona to call `email_campaign_prepare`, `email_campaign_preview`, and `email_campaign_test_send` for exactly one test recipient.
tool_rules.email-campaign-persona-prompt: Builds an approval-gated prompt for a TribeX AI persona to call prepare, preview, optional test send, MCPViews review proposal, send apply only after accepted approval, and status.
tool_rules.email-template-persona-revision-prompt: Builds a revision prompt for a TribeX AI persona to search for the selected HTML template artifact and update the same workspace path with an expected SHA-256 guard.

plugin_rules: The email-deliverability plugin provides the MCPViews template-building UI. It does not send production email directly.

The campaign builder can consume artifacts created by sandbox-write-gated TribeX runtime tools `email_template_artifact_create` and `email_campaign_draft_artifact_create`, including `campaignPreparePayload`, workspace artifact refs, and hashes.

When a selected HTML template is being revised, pass its workspace path, file id, and SHA to the persona and prefer `email_template_artifact_search` plus `email_template_artifact_update`; do not create a new file for revisions unless the user explicitly asks for a copy.
On open, the template builder should first guide the user through selecting a TribeX organization/workspace, then choosing a saved template/campaign draft or creating a new draft.

The default template editing view should stay simple: template name, key, subject, HTML source, variables, deterministic plain text preview, large HTML preview, and save. Campaign handoff fields belong behind advanced details or outside the template editor.

When opened with a workspace id or resolvable thread id, the campaign builder can search durable workspace storage under `email/`, filter by path, and load HTML template, audience, or campaign draft artifacts into the UI.

Template and campaign drafts may be saved as portable JSON artifacts in TribeX AI durable workspace storage through `window.__tribexAiClient` when the renderer is opened with a workspace id or resolvable thread id.

Single test sends and production campaign sends must be mediated through a TribeX AI persona using the platform email_campaign_* tools. Production send apply remains impossible until MCPViews approval is accepted.
